text:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — pilot partner intake. We need one doc that captures scope boundaries, security gating, and success criteria so we don't iterate forever. Who can own the partner-facing agreement and the dev intake form?
Alex (Eng): I can draft a short tech checklist for runtime compatibility and SLOs. Want to shrink scope to an MVE to get data fast.
Priya (CS): I’ll run outreach and pre-qual calls. Can we agree on a greenlist handshake step for legal/compliance partners? small checkbox: "ready for on-prem or VPC"
Jin (SRE): Need to validate network egress and KMS before onboarding. Also we should set a rollout fallback: if Dedicated capacity < X then route to hosted with redaction.
Zoe (Design): Can we include a 15-min unmoderated session + 45-min moderated call in the feedback loop? That cadence worked well before.
Maria (PM): Perfect. Drafting acceptance criteria now — want to lock these before recruiting: 1) 2-week MVE where partner runs 1k inference/day; 2) quality holdout tests with our prompt set; 3) SLA/latency targets met for p95; 4) documented security posture.
Alex (Eng): Quick proposal for SLOs (draft):
```
- latency: p95 < 150ms for 512-token baseline
- throughput: sustained 100 reqs/min per pod during peak tests
- error rate: < 0.5% 5xx during test window
- fallback behavior: deterministic model variant mapping + traffic cap
```
Priya (CS): Outreach script idea: short screening q's, then link to intake form. I can host the form if you want Google -> Notion sync.
Maria (PM): Please make intake form minimal. Use these core fields:
```
- company name
- primary contact + role
- data residency requirement (US/EU/APAC/on-prem)
- expected daily tokens/requests
- baseline correctness metric of interest (e.g., hallucination tolerance)
- legal/compliance checklist: SSO, KMS, DPA needed? (y/n)
- onboarding availability (weeks)
```
Zoe (Design): Add a single checkbox: "available for 1 usability session (45m) + monthly feedback". Keeps engagement measurable.
Jin (SRE): Operational gate: before we enable Dedicated we need a signed security questionnaire + ephemeral test account. Also confirm they can provide sample payloads (sanitized).
Alex (Eng): Two items for scope negotiation: 1) no custom model weights in MVE (use verified open model variants); 2) we won't support advanced quantized tuning during pilot. Keep infra simple.
Priya (CS): Timeline ask — can we onboard 3 partners in the next 8 weeks? I can start outreach tomorrow if criteria are finalized.
Maria (PM): Target: onboard 2 partners in next 6 weeks, keep 1 as a reserve. Success metrics for pilot:
- product: reduction in customer integration time by 30% (self-reported)
- model: no regression on our regression set and <5% relative drop on partner-specific evals
- infra: meet SLOs for 2 consecutive weeks
- ops: documented runbook and rollback tested
Alex (Eng): I’ll add simple telemetry hooks to trace latency by route and model variant. Means we can quantify cost/regression quickly.
Zoe (Design): I'll draft the moderated session script and a short NPS-style micro-survey for the form.
Priya (CS): I'll assemble a candidate list from existing trial customers + our mutual partners. Prioritise those with clear compliance needs (good for Private offering testing).
Maria (PM): Great. Action owners: Alex -> tech checklist + telemetry (due in 4 days). Priya -> outreach + intake form (due in 3 days). Zoe -> session script + micro-survey (due in 5 days). Jin -> ops gating doc + test account flow (due in 4 days). I’ll compile the partner agreement template and legal checklist.
Alex (Eng): One more ask — let's include an explicit rollback SLA in the agreement: if model rollout causes >1% error spike -> auto-scale down and notify partner, plus a 24h post-mortem.
Maria (PM): Agree. Add to partner agreement.
deploy-bot: pilot-env cluster-qa created at https://console.redwood.internal/pilot/qa (image: rwd-inference:pilot-2026-03).
Priya (CS): Nice. I'll ping 6 candidates.
Zoe (Design): Will mock the survey tonight and share a link.
Jin (SRE): I'll prepare a small runbook snippet to test fallback routing: 
```
1) simulate capacity constraint (cpu/gpu throttle)
2) verify traffic redirect to hosted variant
3) validate no secret exfiltration
```
Maria (PM): Thanks team — let's regroup in 5 days for a short demo of intake form + tech checklist. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @legal. :rocket:
